## Question

Is Jev accurate enough to classify articles for Hemiciclo? Build a set of about 60 articles across Spain, the United States, Argentina and India. The owner labels them by hand using the signal criteria. Run Jev on the same set with options shuffled, compare, and decide whether Jev's labels are good enough for v1 and which signals to drop or reword.
